//: Copy to broker.json (same directory) and edit. NOTHING SECRET here — the key is a separate file, provider-key, mode 600. See ../README.md.
//upstream: The provider API ORIGIN only, no path. The incoming request path from opencode is appended unchanged. Examples: https://api.openai.com  |  https://api.anthropic.com  |  https://openrouter.ai
//auth: How the key is attached. For an OpenAI-compatible provider: auth_header 'authorization', auth_value 'Bearer {key}'. For Anthropic's native API: auth_header 'x-api-key', auth_value '{key}', and add anthropic-version to extra_headers.
//meter_file: Defaults to ~/.local/state/phi-agent/a1/broker-meter.jsonl. One JSON object per request.
